PART III - LANDS FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 55 (Mannar) Whereas a settlement notice under Section 4 of the Land Settlement Ordinance was duly published in the Gazette No. 8 of 27th October 1978 and as otherwise required by the said Section, in respect of the lands situated in the village of Mundampiddy, in Vellankulam Grama Niladhari’s Division in Mantai (Now Mantai West) D.R.O’s Division of the Mannar District in the Northern Province and De-scribed as Lot nos. 117, 118, 119, 120, 125, 126, 127, 128, 135, 136, 142 and 143 in Topo preliminary Plan No. 23 (North) (Vide Set-tlement Notice No. 4802 (Mannar)). And whereas all claims received in pursuance of the said notice have been duly dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordinance: I, the undersigned, in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by Section 5(5) of the said Ordinance do hereby make order that the lands or portions thereof be settled as specified in the Schedule to this order. P.M.H.PRIYADHARSHANI, Assistant Settlement Officer Commissioner of - Land Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla 02nd October, 2015.
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
